verdict.rationale: Ashby is an ATS with a public API, webhooks and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test environment, or non-production API keys. The permission scoping in docs-13 and docs-24 is a related control, not isolation from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
